summary: Enhance your career with our Foundation in Insurance Training Course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to excel in the insurance industry today!
lede: Insurance fundamentals training helps insurance practitioners and adjacent teams understand and support the policy lifecycle, from assessing exposures to handling claims and reporting results. Learners map insurance risks, evaluate underwriting information and coverage, and use practical worksheets to calculate simplified premiums and review claims controls; the syllabus also introduces reinsurance, reporting frameworks, and portfolio indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need insurance foundations to perform, supervise, analyze, or support work across the policy lifecycle. It suits hands-on practitioners, operational managers, technical specialists, functional leaders, and adjacent digital roles that interact with underwriting, claims, policy data, reinsurance, finance, or customer conduct.
modules: Insurance KPI Dashboard and Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Basic business-process awareness and elementary spreadsheet use. Coding requirement: No programming is required. Technology requirement: Bring a laptop capable of opening spreadsheet and PDF files. Depth: Insurance operations and basic calculations receive operational application; IFRS 17, actuarial modelling, AI risk scoring, and catastrophe analytics receive conceptual awareness. Course datasets and digital templates are provided.
